subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz sensor telemetry, physical boundary validation, out-of-order reconciliation, append-only recording and windowed streaming to downstream consumers.
subdomain.why_distinct: Differentiating real-time engine (PulseStream Engine) of the endurance analytics platform with its own rules on sensor limits, device-time ordering, immutability and backpressure.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke).
Raw transmission from an edge device, bike computer or wearable carrying one or more samples.
t_device: epoch timestamp generated by the device; the chronological ordering key.
t_ingress: arrival time at the engine; never used for ordering.
Physical physiological/mechanical limit for a metric (e.g. HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, swim pace >45 s/100m).
Demand-driven flow control keeping the ingestion entry point non-blocking under burst load.
60-second tolerance within which delayed samples are re-indexed chronologically by t_device.
Newly appended record that corrects or backfills earlier data without altering it.
Buffered sliding window of ordered samples offered to streaming analytics.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Intake & Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept ingress packets without blocking and judge each sample against sensor metric boundaries.
in_scope: Receiving ingress packets under burst load
invariants: Every sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are flagged VALIDATION_FAILED and never dropped
Ingestion entry point performs no blocking I/O and honors backpressure

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Re-index delayed samples chronologically by device time and buffer ordered windows for analytics.
invariants: Samples delayed up to 60 seconds are ordered by t_device, not t_ingress
source_of_truth: Chronological order of samples within a window

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Ledger
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Durably record raw telemetry and corrections as an append-only, auditable history.
in_scope: Event revisions for corrections and backfills
invariants: Raw time-series records are append-only; corrections append new event revisions
source_of_truth: Persisted raw telemetry records and their revisions

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Broadcast processed telemetry to downstream event streams respecting consumer backpressure.
in_scope: Delivery of windows and samples downstream
invariants: Broadcasting never blocks and respects downstream demand

assumptions.item: Sequencing/windowing, ledger and broadcasting are separate contexts; they could be merged into one engine context.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Merging would make a single pipeline context

assumptions.item: Backpressure invariant applies to intake and broadcasting separately; each owns its own side.
Handling of samples arriving later than the 60-second window is unspecified (revision via ledger assumed).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Sequencing vs ledger responsibility for late data

assumptions.item: Identity of downstream consumers and the sliding window size/slide are unspecified.
